infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Crewdesk records your location when you clock in and out so your manager can verify job-site attendance.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Crewdesk records your location when you clock in and out so your manager can verify job-site attendance.

plugins.cameraPermission: Crewdesk uses the camera to scan QR labels on vehicles and equipment.
Crewdesk uses the camera to photograph documents for your onboarding, like your driver's license.
plugins.photosPermission: Crewdesk lets you pick a photo of a document to upload for your onboarding.
